verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents its own workflow automation tool ('Create workflows in HubSpot to automate your processes'). Sequences send timed emails, which is only adjacent. Nothing in the pack shows workflows can run on a recurring schedule, so the core 'schedule recurring' element is unproven. Missing for 10: documented schedule-based or recurring workflow triggers, programmatic (API/CLI/MCP) control of scheduled jobs for AI-native use, independent or hands-on corroboration.
